The '''2018–19 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Alabama]] in the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by fourth-year head coach [[Avery Johnson]] and played its home games at [[Coleman Coliseum]] in [[Tuscaloosa, Alabama]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 18–16, 8–10 in [[2018–19 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a tie for ninth place in SEC play. They defeated [[2018-19 Ole Miss Rebels men's basketball team|Ole Miss]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401119814|title=Alabama vs. Ole Miss – Game Recap – March 14, 2019 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-10-08}}</ref> to advance to the quarterfinals of the [[2019 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] where they lost to [[2018-19 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401119823|title=Alabama vs. Kentucky – Game Recap – March 15, 2019 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-10-08}}</ref> They received an invitation to the [[2019 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.montgomeryadvertiser.com/story/sports/2019/03/17/alabama-appears-nit-bound-after-missing-ncaa-tournament-field/3194077002/|title=Alabama draws No. 1 seed in NIT after missing NCAA Tournament field|last=Byington|first=Alex|website=The Montgomery Advertiser|language=en|access-date=2019-10-08}}</ref> where they lost in the first round to [[2018–19 Norfolk State Spartans men's basketball team|Norfolk State]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401123724|title=Norfolk State vs. Alabama – Game Recap – March 20, 2019 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-10-08}}</ref>

On March 24, 2019, the school fired head coach Avery Johnson.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2827127-avery-johnson-fired-as-alabama-basketball-head-coach-after-4-seasons-with-team|title=Avery Johnson Fired as Alabama Basketball Head Coach After 4 Seasons with Team|last=Newport|first=Kyle|website=Bleacher Report|language=en|access-date=2019-10-08}}</ref> A few days later, the school hired [[Buffalo Bulls men's basketball|Buffalo]] head coach [[Nate Oats]] as coach.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/26374216/alabama-hires-buffalo-oats-head-coach|title=Alabama hires Buffalo's Oats as head coach|date=2019-03-27|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-10-08}}</ref>

==Previous season==
The [[2017–18 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Crimson Tide]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 20–16, 8–10 in [[2017–18 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a tie for ninth place. They defeated [[2017–18 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]] and [[2017–18 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team|Auburn]] in the [[2018 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2017–18 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2017–18 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team|Virginia Tech]] in the first round<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401025832|title=Alabama vs. Virginia Tech – Game Recap – March 15, 2018 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-10-08}}</ref> before losing in the second round to [[2017–18 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401025862|title=Alabama vs. Villanova – Game Recap – March 17, 2018 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-10-08}}</ref>
